app.name: PnP Cards
app.tagline: Print and play cards, ready to print

nav.donateHint: Support the project with a PayPal donation

cards.empty: Drop your card images here or press “Add images”.
cards.emptyHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or TIFF. A name ending in “ x3” adds 3 copies.
cards.dropHere: Drop the images to add them
cards.heicOffline: HEIC photos need a connection the first time, to download their converter. Connect to the internet and add them again.
cards.noDpi: Some images don’t state their resolution and will be treated as 72 dpi. Force the card width or height under Card size so they print at the right size.
cards.lowDpi_one: {{count}} card will print at low resolution (under {{min}} dpi at its print size) and may look blurry. Look for a bigger image or print it smaller.
cards.lowDpi_other: {{count}} cards will print at low resolution (under {{min}} dpi at their print size) and may look blurry. Look for bigger images or print them smaller.
cards.printNote: When printing, choose actual size or 100 % scale, not “Fit to page”: otherwise the cards come out smaller.
cards.errorEmpty: There are no cards to print: they all have zero copies.
cards.errorBlank: Blank images take their size from another card. Add an image or force the width and height under Card size.
cards.errorUnknown: The PDF could not be created ({{message}}). Try fewer images or check that none are damaged.
cards.ignoredWithProject_one: The project was opened; the other dropped image wasn’t added.
cards.ignoredWithProject_other: The project was opened; the other {{count}} dropped images weren’t added.
cards.missingWarning_one: {{count}} image can’t be found and won’t be printed. Find it or remove it.
cards.missingWarning_other: {{count}} images can’t be found and won’t be printed. Find them or remove them.
cards.errorTemplate: Choose a template with at least one slot under Layout.
cards.clearMessage: The list will be empty. You can add the images again whenever you like.
cards.dividerHint: Drag to change the preview width; double-click for the default width
cards.errorNoBack: Choose the back image under Settings › Backs, or turn backs off.

settings.headerHint: Project name and page number, small and grey, in the free space: top, bottom or down the side. If it fits nowhere, it isn’t drawn.
settings.rulerHint: Adds a 50 mm bar in the bottom margin of the first page. Measure it with a ruler: if it isn’t 50 mm, the printer is scaling the page. If there aren’t 4 mm free at the bottom or top, it isn’t drawn.
settings.sizeHint: If you don’t force a size, each image’s resolution is used.
settings.presetHint: A chosen size forces the width and height; change them and it becomes “Custom”.
settings.autoRotateHint: If a card does not match the orientation of the layout, it is rotated 90° to fit its slot.
settings.inkSaverHint: Prints cards and backs in lighter greyscale, to use less ink on playtest copies. Cut lines stay as they are.
settings.noTemplates: You don’t have any templates yet.
settings.templateMarks: With a template, each slot gets crop marks at its corners.
settings.backsHint: Each page of cards is followed by a page with their backs, mirrored, for double-sided printing.
settings.backNone: You haven't chosen the back image yet.
settings.backMissing: {{name}} can't be found. Choose it again.
settings.backFit: It's fitted to each card; if its shape differs, it's cropped to the centre.
settings.backPerCard: To leave a card without a back, mark it in its info panel.
settings.printerHint: If the backs come out shifted, print the test sheet double-sided, hold it up to the light to see how far apart the crosses are, and enter it here.
settings.offsetHint: Negative values: left or down. “Right” and “up” are those of the backs page as it comes out of the printer. It's a setting of your printer: it's kept in this browser and doesn't change when you open another project.

sheet.title: Alignment test sheet
sheet.flipLong: Paper flip: on the long edge
sheet.flipShort: Paper flip: on the short edge
sheet.step1: 1. Print this PDF double-sided, at actual size (100 %, no “fit to page”), with the paper flip shown above.
sheet.step2: 2. Check with a ruler that the square is 50 mm on each side. If not, check the scale in the print dialog.
sheet.step3: 3. Hold the sheet up to the light with the back (page 2) facing you and its text upright: you'll see the front cross through the paper.
sheet.step4: 4. On each ruler on the back, read the mark the front cross line passes through and enter that value, with its sign, under Settings › Backs › Printer adjustment. If the crosses coincide, leave 0.
sheet.backStep: Hold the sheet up to the light from this side. The vertical line of the front cross crosses the bottom ruler at the value for “Move backs right”; the horizontal line crosses the right ruler at the value for “Move backs up”.

preview.empty: Add cards to see how each page will look.
preview.label: Preview of page {{page}}
preview.clamped_one: The crop doesn’t fit {{count}} card; it will be fitted to its edge.
preview.clamped_other: The crop doesn’t fit {{count}} cards; it will be fitted to each card’s edge.
preview.headerMissing: The header doesn’t fit: there aren’t 3 mm free at the top, bottom or left.
preview.rulerMissing: The check ruler doesn’t fit: there aren’t 4 mm free at the bottom or top.

crop.title: Crop
crop.zeroHint: 0 mm uses the whole image in that direction.
crop.clamped: The crop doesn’t fit this image and is fitted to its edge.
crop.hint: Drag the rectangle or move it with the arrow keys (Shift moves 10 px).
crop.noImages: Add an image to adjust the crop.

project.name: Project name
project.invalid: {{name}} isn’t a PnP Cards or PDFCartas project.
project.newer: {{name}} was saved with a newer version of PnP Cards. Reload the page to update it.
project.saveFailed: The project couldn’t be saved. Try another folder.
project.unsavedMessage: Anything you haven’t saved in the current project will be lost.

folder.title: Open “{{name}}”
folder.intro_one: The project uses {{count}} image. Point to the folder it’s in: it is found by its path or, failing that, its name.
folder.intro_other: The project uses {{count}} images. Point to the folder they’re in: they are found by their path or, failing that, their name.
folder.restoreTitle: Pick up where you left off?
folder.restoreIntro_one: Your last session was “{{name}}”, with {{count}} image. To continue, open its folder again.
folder.restoreIntro_other: Your last session was “{{name}}”, with {{count}} images. To continue, open its folder again.
folder.hint: Last time the images were in the “{{name}}” folder.
folder.denied: No permission to read the folder. Press again and choose “Allow”, or choose the folder.
folder.gone: The “{{name}}” folder can’t be found. It may have moved: choose it again.

recent.title: Recent projects
recent.empty: Projects you open or save will appear here.
recent.note: Only the project and its folder are remembered; the images stay in your folder.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.intro: Combine several PDFs into one, in list order. Drag to change the order.
merge.empty: Drop the PDFs you want to merge here or press “Add PDFs”.
merge.unreadable: Can’t be read: it’s damaged or password-protected.
merge.needTwo: Add at least two PDFs to merge them.
merge.errorUnreadable: {{name}} couldn’t be read: it’s damaged or password-protected. Remove it and try again.
merge.dropHere: Drop the PDFs to add them
merge.notPdf_one: {{names}} isn’t a PDF and wasn’t added.
merge.clearTitle: Remove all PDFs from the list?

split.title: Split image
split.intro: Cut sheets with several cards into one image per card. Adjust the area, rows and columns; parts are saved as PNG, with no loss of quality.
split.empty: Drop the sheets you want to split here or press “Add images”.
split.dropHere: Drop the images to add them
split.partSizeUneven: Each part: about {{w}} × {{h}} px ({{wmm}} × {{hmm}} mm); the remainder is shared out
split.hint: Drag the area to move it and its corners to resize it, or move it with the arrow keys (Shift moves 10 px).
split.clearTitle: Remove all images from the list?

extract.title: Extract images
extract.intro: Pull out the images inside a PDF, at their original resolution, or each whole page as an image. Repeated ones are saved once, with “ xN” in the name.
extract.empty: Drop a PDF here or press “Choose PDF”.
extract.dropHere: Drop the PDF to open it
extract.ignoreSmallHint: Icons and ornaments that aren’t cards.
extract.none: This PDF has no images to extract.
extract.encrypted: {{name}} is password-protected and can’t be read.
extract.pagesHint: Each page as one image. Useful when the cards are drawn as vectors, built from several layers or cut into strips.
extract.cantRead: Can’t be read: it’s damaged or password-protected.
extract.big: At this resolution each page takes a lot of memory. If it fails, lower the dpi.
extract.pageSize: The first page will be {{w}} × {{h}} px.
extract.rangeInvalid: Enter pages between 1 and {{count}}, for example “1-3, 5”.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Place the slots wherever you like: each card fills one slot, in the order of their numbers. To use it, choose “Template” in the Cards layout.
templates.empty: Create a blank template or one from the layout you use in Cards.
templates.name: Name
templates.noSlot: Choose a slot to edit it, or add one.
templates.hint: Drag the slots to move them and their corners to resize them (to the millimetre). With a slot selected, the arrow keys move it 1 mm (Shift: 10 mm).
templates.outside: Some slots go off the page.
templates.removeMessage: It is deleted from this browser. Projects that use it keep their copy.

cardInfo.title: Card {{position}} of {{total}}
cardInfo.slot: The size of its template slot
cardInfo.blank: Blank image: the PDF leaves a gap the size of the previous card.
cardInfo.missing: This image can’t be found in the project folder.

pwa.newVersion: A new version of PnP Cards is available.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Your images, PDFs and projects never leave your computer: everything happens in the browser.
privacy.stats: To learn which tools are used and improve the app, visits and some actions are counted anonymously with GoatCounter, without cookies or identifiers.
measuredItems: That a PDF is created, with the number of pages and cards in ranges and the options used (layout, crop, cutting, double-sided).
Errors and cancellations, only by their code.
That a project is opened or saved, a folder is added or a tool is used.
Language, theme and whether the app is installed. Browser, system and country come from the service itself.
neverItems: Images, file names, project names or folder paths.
Anything that identifies you: no cookies, no identifiers, no full IP address.
privacy.doNotTrack: Your browser asks not to be tracked, so nothing is sent.
